comments.author: Me
comments.body: I am currently working on getting Ambon to attain Central Capital status, Culure level is 42k+ atm, Trade is 25k, and Maritime is 30k. Is there anything I need to know regarding which items besides RIB's, QMP's and Seals(Sylph, Gnome etc>) to give to the Shop Keeper, and anything I need to know regarding what type of ships to donate to the Shipyard Master? The Shipyard Master wouldn't accept a 1/5 High Clipper I had built by an r20 SB just for the purpose of giving it to him. Does a ship that is donated have to be modded at least once with SSIP to be acceptable for donation? Any information would be greatly appreciated. IGN: CullumStraun aka The White Tiger, Director, new_world_company, Lisbon

comments.author: Stinker
comments.body:
oops! I deleted the old post. What I was going to say what that there are also other benefits with further developing Ambon (and Ternate) such as trade goods. Here we go again:

Consumables or ships aren't worth delivering in my opinion. Good items (points per effort or cost) for Ambon are the following:

Commerce
jewelled turbans
yellow and red gem books (about 5 times as many points as turbans)
clothier and harlequin books (about 3 times as many points as gem books)

Armament
large extra spankers
silver-plated armours (about 5 times as many points as spankers)

Culture
Danu figureheads

See ogplanet post about sudden regression of cayman for more info.
